method: Velocity Verlet (symplectic, 2nd order) at dt=0.05 and dt=0.025 to t=200*T_1; MEASURED is the first recurrence peak time (mode-1 energy E_1 max within the first hump where E_1 > 0.5*E_1(0) after collapse), in units of T_1 = 2*pi/omega_1 = 66.024930
notes: Verify2 (second pass, after fix stage): two full runs gave bit-identical stdout numeric lines (MEASURED=153.4345, PUBLISHED=157.0000, ERROR_ESTIMATE=0.4014, TOLERANCE=7.3457, ABS_DIFF=3.5655, RESULT=PASS in both runs, exit code 0 both times); only the printed RUNTIME_S line differed (21.56 s vs 21.43 s), so the result is deterministic (no seed is used; the integration is a deterministic ODE solve, no RNG).
